verdict.rationale: Relay explicitly supports uploading bills, delegating tasks/roles, and automating multi-step approval workflows before paying vendors (relay-docs-4, relay-docs-17, relay-docs-27, relay-docs-28), backed by a dedicated support article on setting up payment approvals. Community feedback confirms real-world use of account partitioning and payments, though notes manual execution steps for some external payments. Missing for 10: independent hands-on review specifically validating the bill-upload-to-approval-to-payment flow end-to-end, and detail on approval routing logic/customization depth.
